verdict.rationale: Vanta has a structured per-endpoint API reference on its developer hub (e.g., the List Tests page and the Auditor API overview). Its SDKs are generated from an OpenAPI specification, and a quickstart walks through calling the API with an access token. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and probes found no public OpenAPI file at the common paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or executable request examples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration
